hardware_observation.screen: legacy lisp65 line and row-1 prompt; no banner

root_cause.summary: The generator emitted the banner ordinal, but src/repl.c did not include the generated stdlib header. Its conditional compiled the legacy fallback into the real product while the host visual oracle invoked %repl-banner directly.
root_cause.missing_edge: generated stdlib header -> native REPL translation unit
root_cause.class: binding completeness: implementation and direct oracle green while the product launch edge is absent

mechanism: src/repl.c includes the generated stdlib header when that contract is active.
Compilation fails if the generated banner ordinal is absent.
probe_fix.negative_gate: pass: a generated header without the banner entry is rejected during preprocessing
probe_fix.binary_binding: pass: final repl disassembly calls vm_run_dir with ordinal 198 immediately after scr_init

capacity_correction.attribution: The real generated-ordinal vm_run_dir launch replaces the smaller legacy emit_str fallback. No Lisp blob, symbol, namepool, directory, or overlay-owned source changed.

recommendation: Authorize the corrected three-byte Bank debit and two-byte overlay-headroom correction. A reclaim sweep for five effective bytes would not serve a capacity contract; both floors remain met and the measured 68-byte eventqueue path retains 12 bytes of projected overlay margin.
